text: The initiative features rapid central financing to bypass local fiscal constraints, a dual mandate of post-disaster reconstruction and long-term resilience, and a strong focus on river-basin systems. It includes explicit urban drainage upgrades and integration with high-standard farmland and irrigation rehabilitation. The program's fast allocation cadence resulted in full allocation to approximately 15,000 projects by March 2024.

metadata.solution_name: Additional 1 Trillion Yuan Central Government Bonds for Disaster Relief and Flood Prevention (2023–2024)
